standing: Root preliminary read of initial blind oslib.py. Independent reviewer is still authoring and testing. No feedback supplied and no final finding or verdict inferred. Recheck final source before adopting any limitation.
observations: Full helper source read, including own raw scanner, C/H, CVE1, capability admission, clone frame, schema resolver and CAS. It does not import author models.

Initial _c checks depth before scalar dispatch, potentially rejecting scalar leaves below32container depth although raw scanner counts containers correctly. This is a possible blind-helper bug with a precise existing normative rule, not itself a design gap.

Initial ADM-CLOSED records missing keys but then indexes m[providers]/m[coverageForAbsent] before returning errors; missing arrays may escape as KeyError. Positive-schema claims and negative first-boundary counts must be read precisely.
Initial CVE1 decoder explicitly claims only decode(encode(x)) roundtrip. It omits several raw-length/bounds/signed admission checks, so it is not evidence of full arbitrary-byte CVE1 admission.
Initial raw-string low-surrogate escape parses int(hx2,16) without validating digits, so malformed paired escape may raise ValueError rather than Refused. No product envelope mapping inferred.
CAS.get refuses missingbytes; complete Run graph closure and retaining all referenced schema/native artifacts remain to be built and executed.
